name: Homepage
description: Tableau de bord ultra-configurable pour vos services.
compose:
services:
  homepage:
    image: ghcr.io/gethomepage/homepage:latest
    container_name: homepage
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - HOMEPAGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS=*
    ports:
      - "3004:3000"
    volumes:
      - {{APPDATA}}/config:/app/config

en.description: A highly configurable dashboard for your services.
